If anything the internet has been a double-edged sword in that regard, with how people can so very easily search and find communities that share their views and morals -- even at the risk of getting information that turns out to be slanderous, propaganda, or just an outright lie. The onus is on us (haha, I love that sentence,) to stay vigilant and take advantage of the wealth of knowledge that we still have access to.

Read different sources and the viewpoints of people who make you cringe. Take the intellectual risk of standing in someone else's footsteps and analyze your own stances on issues. Peppered throughout every news article and blog, in all the press releases and leaked document are nuggets of truth buried amongst the BS. I would like to think that people all have a good bullshit detector, but like any muscle, it has to be exercised and stretched to stay effective.
